responsibility: Defines the PowerPC Darwin-specific command-line options and aliases used by GCC’s option machinery. It introduces Darwin driver/target switches such as -faltivec and -m32/-m64 along with compatibility aliases for fix-and-continue behavior, connecting those options to rs6000 target variables and Darwin-specific driver handling.
same_name_distinction: This is the Darwin option table for the rs6000 port, declaring switches and aliases such as -faltivec, -m32, -m64, and fix-and-continue compatibility options. Unlike darwin.h, it does not set ABI macros or specs, and unlike darwin.md, it contains no RTL patterns.
